visualInspection.method: Actual original files viewed with view_image; no generated/enhanced/cropped substitutes
visualInspection.verdict: Bounded palette readability improvement accepted for these controlled views; freeze this slice and continue planned regression. No request for further source changes during Full1.
observations: Default26 now clearly separates a warmer pale-ochre inner deposition band from olive turf; the wider west/inner shoulder reads without needing the close-up.
Close16 makes the same improvement obvious. Dark wet rim remains visible, grass is not globally recolored, and the inspected images show no severe white clipping or washed-out river.
The outer east contact line retains small polygonal notches, especially beside the upper tree line. This palette change is not a geometry fix.

Overview and bridge/harbor-pad current frames are consistent with the warm sediment palette. Harbor frame shows reserved shoreline context and map edge, not a built dock. Protected areas may change sand tint wherever existing weights are nonzero.
visualInspection.remainingKnownIssue: Outer contact-line polygonal notches; no causal geometry diagnosis or repair established.
